decision.summary: Undefined orientation evaluations do not invalidate established classifications, but they prevent Excl_obs_x from claiming total-family closure.

semantic_rules: UNDEFINED is neither TRUE nor FALSE.
Undefined evaluation for one orientation does not revoke witnesses established for others.
Any nonempty Omega_x_undef prevents total Excl_obs_x classification.
Omega_x_undef remains explicit provenance and may not be discarded.
TOTAL_ORIENTATION_EXCLUSION requires Omega_x_pos = empty and Omega_x_undef = empty.
Omega_x_pos = empty with Omega_x_undef nonempty is INDETERMINATE_ADMISSIBILITY.

result_states.PARTIAL_CLASSIFICATION: Omega_x_undef != empty and (Omega_x_pos != empty or Omega_x_neg != empty)

partial_exception.name: PARTIAL_SUFFICIENCY_WITNESS
partial_exception.required_statement: A selected admissible orientation remains admissible and reference-determining under every permitted resolution of Omega_x_undef.
partial_exception.effect: RefOrient may proceed provisionally without treating unresolved orientations as excluded.

downstream_policy.prohibited_inference: One admissible orientation does not prove unresolved orientations are irrelevant.

delta_a_bridge.true: AdmObs_x(o) = TRUE permits Gamma_O for that orientation.
delta_a_bridge.false: AdmObs_x(o) = FALSE rejects Gamma_O for that orientation.
delta_a_bridge.undefined: AdmObs_x(o) = UNDEFINED leaves Gamma_O undefined and cannot produce positive delta_a admission.
delta_a_bridge.restriction: Undefined is not coerced to FALSE.

rationale: Blocking the entire family discards valid local witnesses.
Coercing undefined to exclusion confuses missing evaluation with negative evaluation.
Explicit partial classification preserves unresolved distinction as residue.
Totality remains a stronger closure property rather than an assumption.

authorized_chain.total_path: AdmObs_x evaluations -> Excl_obs_x total partition -> RefOrient -> [Asym]_x -> <S>_x
authorized_chain.partial_path: AdmObs_x evaluations -> Excl_obs_x partial partition -> unresolved residue OR PartialSufficiencyWitness -> provisional RefOrient

next_action: Define PartialSufficiencyWitness and determine whether provisional RefOrient outputs may enter delta_a or remain non-realizing candidates.
